name: In Silico Twin (IST) Evaluation Framework
description: An In Silico Twin (IST) is a high-fidelity, AI-augmented computational replica of an individual's biological systems, integrating mechanistic models (such as PBPK or QSP) with patient-specific data streams from EHRs and wearables. Unlike traditional digital twins with one-way data flow, ISTs feature bidirectional integration directly into clinical decision support or therapy control loops, enabling real-time simulation and optimization of personalized treatments. The FDA V&V40/EMA M&S Framework provides regulatory qualification pathways for these complex models.
reputation: Emerging paradigm in personalized medicine and clinical AI; FDA-recognized evaluation pathway; exemplified by FDA-cleared systems such as HeartFlow FFR-CT.
notes: Represents the most advanced form of dynamic, self-evolving simulation environments applied to medicine. Continuously learns from patient data streams. Regulatory framework (V&V40) is required for clinical deployment. LLMs (e.g., LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA-3) are being integrated for ICU medication prediction.
